properties.description: Robyn Rihanna Fenty is a Barbadian singer, songwriter, actress and entrepreneur whose career spans multiple genres from dancehall and R&B to pop and EDM. She rose to international fame with early hits like "Pon de Replay" and the breakthrough global single "Umbrella," earning numerous chart records and Grammys. Beyond music, Rihanna is a major cultural and business figure — founding Fenty Beauty and Savage X Fenty, serving as a cultural ambassador for Barbados, and receiving the title of National Hero. Her work is noted for genre-blending production, bold image reinventions, and widespread commercial and cultural impact.

Tinie Tempah, born Patrick Chukwuemeka Okogwu, is a British rapper, singer, and songwriter who rose to fame in the early 2010s with his debut album 'Disc-Overy'. He is known for blending grime, hip hop, and pop elements in his music, achieving commercial success with hits like 'Pass Out' and 'Written in the Stars'. His work is characterized by energetic beats, catchy hooks, and a versatile vocal delivery.

Pharrell Williams is an American singer, rapper, songwriter, and record producer who rose to fame as part of the production duo The Neptunes and the band N.E.R.D. He is known for his distinctive falsetto voice and blending of hip hop, R&B, funk, and pop music. They rose from Merseybeat roots and early residencies in Hamburg to global fame during the 1960s. Under manager Brian Epstein and producer George Martin they evolved rapidly from catchy pop singles to studio-focused, genre-expanding albums that reshaped popular music and culture worldwide.

His work is characterized by energetic beats, catchy hooks, and a versatile vocal delivery.

He is noted for blending hip-hop, funk and electronic production, high-profile collaborations, and ventures in fashion and technology (including the i.am clothing line and i.am Antik denim). He has produced and written for many artists and engaged in political and social media projects such as the ‘Yes We Can’ Obama video.
